$comment: 🔮️ Test-only third-party references of the repo move module. There are none: every operation this module performs is defined by this repository's own conventions, so the evidence is recorded specification vectors plus metamorphic laws. Once the Go twin package exists the committed 🐹️.go adapters become subjects automatically and pairwise cross-implementation parity is added on top of, not instead of, these decisions.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: The repository-wide rename rewrites exactly three foldings of a token — the whole token upper-cased, the whole token lower-cased, and the lower-cased token with its first byte upper-cased — and nothing else. A general case-conversion library instead re-splits a token into words and re-spells it, so it disagrees by construction on every camel, pascal, kebab and snake spelling this repository actually renames. There is no third party that shares this definition; confidence comes from recorded vectors covering all five spellings plus the tree-level walk order.

Section markers, the header region, the import block and the package declaration are this repository's own file grammar, driven by its own language table. No external tool knows that a section is a comment-prefixed region marker whose name carries an entity emoji, that a header is the section literally called Header, or that integrating merges two headers by inserting the unseen source lines above the target's closing marker. Confidence comes from recorded before-and-after vectors across five languages plus the round trip that renaming a section back restores the file byte for byte.

Moving a file or a folder also rewrites the AGENTS.md headings that name the old path, which is a convention of this repository and of nothing else. A filesystem library moves bytes and knows nothing about the documentation index. Confidence comes from recorded before-and-after workspaces plus the round trip that moving a subtree back restores the whole workspace, documentation index included.
